Priya (Partnerships): Quick update — CobaltRetail signed a 12-month renewal for Dedicated and published our integration as an ISV offer on AWS Marketplace. Team celebration! :tada:
Dev (Solutions Eng): Nice. They switched to our optimized reranker flow and are now using the FP16 + cache profile. Early metrics show median p95 latency down ~30% on peak traffic.
Tom (Product): Feature callouts we highlighted in the listing: model pinning, autoscale burst, and offline eval support for their scoring pipelines.
Leah (Marketing): Can we get a customer soundbite and a screenshot of their dashboard? Planning a short case study + marketplace spotlight next week.
Priya (Partnerships): CobaltRetail Head of ML approved this one-liner: "Redwood's dedicated runtime let us scale real-time recommendations with predictable latency and lower cost." Ibrahim will sign off on publishing.
Ibrahim (Legal): Confirmed — legal cleared the quote and minor redactions. Priya, please attach the signed approval form to the shared drive.
Dev (Solutions Eng): Deployment notes for eng: when onboarding their staging account, set the routing policy to prefer us-east-2 for BR latency, and enable prefix KV cache for sessionized shoppers. Example config snippet in internal repo.
Priya (Partnerships): Hand-off plan: Solutions to run 2-day cutover, CS to own the 30-day SLA check, Marketing to draft case study, Partnerships to coordinate PR with AWS marketplace team.
Leah (Marketing): Drafting now — will ping for review. Also request a short 1-paragraph technical blurb from Product by EOD Wednesday.
deploy-bot: Deployment completed for customer cobaltretail-prod on dedicated-cluster-4. All checks green.
Tom (Product): I'll drop the blurb in the document and link perf samples. Congrats team!
Priya (Partnerships): Huge thanks everyone, especially Solutions and Legal. Let's post a short note to #announcements once Marketing confirms assets. :rocket:
